Response call from Look Sharp Victoria Street regarding two individuals who attempted theft. Staff stopped them and retrieved the items. Incident occurred ~10 minutes prior to reporting.

Response call from Lovisa reporting a female who had stolen items, last seen walking up Queen Street.

Guards stopped the female outside Starbucks and safely recovered the stolen items. Female verbally trespassed from Lovisa. She appeared mentally unstable and was screaming in public; last seen continuing up Queen Street. Bodycam footage captured. Items returned to Lovisa.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 18:00)
items: Team 2 — Guards: Beni Mafi and Henry Hakaumotu. Rostered 09:00–17:00; completed overtime to 18:00 due to a late incident. Equipment: 1x Camera, 1x Radio, 2x Vests.
Briefing completed and equipment checked. Commenced patrols from headquarters onto upper Queen Street, conducting welfare checks and maintaining visible presence.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Comprehensive welfare check completed. All clear.
Assisted a member of the public who requested directions, directing them to the correct location. Patrols continued.

09:00–12:00 patrol cycle (Upper Queen Street section): patrolled Upper Queen Street, Federal Street, Upper Albert Street, Victoria Street, Lorne Street, Elliott Street, Darby Street, Wellesley Street West, and Myers Street.
Welfare checks completed across the Upper Queen Street section; all staff spoken to and no issues reported.
Upper Queen Street retail stores and businesses
Elliott Street and Darby Street businesses
Upper Albert Street and Victoria Street businesses
Returned towards headquarters for route changeover with Team 1.
Team 1 arrived at headquarters. Route changeover commenced.

12:20–16:30 patrol cycle (Lower Queen Street section): patrolled Lower Queen Street, Queen Street, Victoria Street, Wyndham Street / Chemist Warehouse area, High Street, Vulcan Lane, Chancery Square, Fort Street, Fort Lane, Gore Street, St Patrick’s Cathedral, Albert Street, and Lower Albert Street.

Shortly after a welfare check at Elliott Stables, Team 2 heard a loud commotion near the Civic bus station and observed a physical altercation between two female vagrants. Team quickly separated both and directed them to take separate routes. Stood by before continuing patrols.
Patrols continued towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks on stores, staff, and businesses.

After welfare checks around Commercial Bay, Team 2 observed Team 1 chasing a female shoplifter. Team 2 blocked the female and attempted to de-escalate; she became extremely frustrated and aggressive and ran towards the train station. Train staff were advised she had shoplifted. She was arrested shortly after by Police. Patrols continued.

While walking back towards headquarters for a 30-minute break, Team 2 noticed a guard requesting assistance and ran over. Multiple shoplifters were apprehended and all items returned. Police were called and handled the matter. Total value of recovered items was $1,083.91.
Returned to headquarters to finish reports and complete Auror incident reports.
Reports completed. Equipment accounted for and handover completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Body Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Keycards, 4x Sets of Keys, 1x Phone Charger.
Afternoon shift deployed. Guards assisted Team 2 with a situation outside the Civic and stood by.
Call from Cotton On regarding a female individual attempting to steal.
Arrived at Cotton On. Manager requested guards stand by outside the door as the female was still inside.
Female exited the store. Guards stopped her and asked her to surrender stolen items. She complied.
Manager advised the female still had stolen items on her. Guards caught up with her outside Mecca Queen Street.
Guards asked the female to surrender the remaining stolen items. She failed to comply and ran towards Commercial Bay. Guards followed while contacting law enforcement.
Team 2 informed the female was heading into Waitematā Train Station. Team 2 located her and followed her onto the platform.
Law enforcement arrived on Platform 1 at Waitematā Train Station and arrested the female from the Cotton On incident. Guards provided details to law enforcement.
Guards headed back up Queen Street.
Noticed a sensor alarm sounding inside Peter Alexander as a male exited. Guards instructed him to return the stolen goods. He complied with no issues.
Arrived at Cotton On Queen Street and informed staff that law enforcement had detained the female and stolen goods would be retrieved and returned.
Stood by for nearby response calls; monitored for issues or vagrants.
Stolen goods retrieved from the Cotton On female POI were returned to Cotton On. Photo provided.
